summary: Owns the in-memory protobuf message channel implementation shared by local and signal routing flows.
responsibilities: Create message channels associated with a LiveKit connection ID.
Provide thread-safe sink/source behavior over a Go channel.
Close message channels once and notify optional close hooks.

summary: Default buffer size for routing message channels.
Thread-safe message channel that implements message sink/source behavior for protobuf messages tied to a connection ID.

inner.summary: Connection identifier associated with messages sent through this channel.
Optional callback invoked when the channel closes.
Records whether the channel has been closed.
Guards channel state and close callback registration.

summary: Creates a message channel with the default routing buffer size.
Creates a message channel with a caller-specified buffer size and connection ID.
Registers the callback invoked when the message channel is closed.
Reports whether the message channel has been closed under a read lock.
Writes a protobuf message to the channel without blocking, returning channel state or capacity errors when the write cannot proceed.
summary_step: 1. Locks channel state and rejects writes after closure with ErrChannelClosed.
2. Attempts a non-blocking send into the buffered channel.
3. Returns nil when the message is enqueued or ErrChannelFull when the buffer is full.

summary: Exposes the channel as a read-only protobuf message stream.
Closes the message channel once and invokes the registered close callback when present.
summary_step: 1. Locks channel state and returns when already closed.
2. Marks the channel closed and closes the underlying message channel.
3. Invokes the optional close callback after the channel is closed.

summary: Returns the LiveKit connection ID associated with this message channel.
